title: About
text:
Research experience

Research Assistant to Dr Aoife Brophy and Dr Mark Workman
Smith School of Environment and Enterprise, University of Oxford · Nov 2023 – Oct 2025

Conducted scoping and targeted literature reviews across greenhouse gas removal technologies, synthesising evidence from more than 100 academic papers and identifying research gaps to support publications and research grant proposals.
Modelled business cases and uncertainty across greenhouse gas removal technologies under alternative policy scenarios using R.
Worked collaboratively with economists, climate scientists, engineers, and policy researchers on interdisciplinary environmental research.



Summer Student Researcher to Dr Mirabel Muules
Imperial College Business School · Jun 2023 – Jul 2023
Contributed to an ongoing randomised controlled trial examining the adoption and use of smart-plug technologies and supported research design, implementation, and data collection.


Research Associate
Research Cell, Confederation of Nepalese Industries · May 2021 – May 2022
Designed and analysed quarterly industrial surveys covering more than 70 medium and large industries across Nepal and produced evidence-based reports to support industrial policy and government decision-making.


Consultant, Study team
National Reconstruction Authority, Nepal · Sep 2021 – Nov 2021
Evaluated the socioeconomic impacts of post-earthquake reconstruction using applied regression-based analysis and contributed to the final evaluation report for government stakeholders.


Junior Consultant
International Labour Organization, Nepal · Jun 2021 – Jul 2021
Analysed municipal budgets and employment programmes using regression-based methods and contributed to policy reports evaluating employment outcomes and evidence-based planning across local governments.


Research Intern to Prof. Ashwini Deshpande
Centre for Economic Data & Analysis, Ashoka University · May 2020 – Aug 2020
Worked with large-scale Indian census datasets, including data reshaping, cleaning, processing, and variable creation in R for the CEDA data portal.


Research Assistant to Dr Biswo Poudel
Nepal · Jun 2019 – Aug 2019
Conducted policy analysis of municipal budgets and public expenditure, and examined federal budget allocations from 2003–2018 to understand employment-generation patterns, policies, and projects.

title: Research
text: My research sits at the intersection of environmental economics, climate policy, and applied microeconomics. I am particularly interested in empirical and policy-relevant questions around the transition to net zero, including the role of institutions, technologies, investment, and evidence in shaping climate and environmental outcomes.

title: Research
section: Green growth and the net-zero transition
text:
Green growth and the net-zero transition
My DPhil research is titled Green Growth Strategies Towards the Net-zero Transition: Low- and Middle-Income Countries Edition. The project focuses on the economic and policy challenges involved in aligning growth and development with decarbonisation in low- and middle-income countries.

title: Research
text:
Carbon dioxide removal
My Oxford research has included work on greenhouse gas removal technologies, including evidence synthesis, uncertainty, investment pathways, and policy scenarios. This work involved reviewing evidence across more than 100 academic papers, identifying research gaps, and modelling business cases under alternative policy scenarios in R.
This strand of work has contributed to research publications and policy outputs on carbon dioxide removal and the wider net-zero transition.
